# Era economy branches for every country (ICX). Generated by icx_gen.py.
ICX_gdp_money = {
	# temp var ICX_gdp_share = share of GDP to add to the treasury (negative to spend)
	set_temp_variable = { money_change_temp = grossdomesticproduct }
	multiply_temp_variable = { money_change_temp = ICX_gdp_share }
	cwic_change_money = yes
}
ICX_dev_build_civ = {
	random_owned_controlled_state = {
		limit = { is_core_of = ROOT free_building_slots = { building = industrial_complex size > 0 include_locked = yes } }
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
}

ICX_dev_upgrade_state = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = ICX_dev_upgrade_state_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		random_owned_controlled_state = {
			limit = { is_core_of = ROOT BRM_x_can_upgrade = yes }
			Upgrade_State_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
ICX_dev_econ_market = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = ICX_dev_econ_market_tt
	hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { check_variable = { economic_x_axis < 19 } } step_towards_market = yes } }
}

ICX_dev_econ_private = {

}
ICX_dev_econ_step_up = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = ICX_dev_econ_step_up_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { economic_x_axis = 21 } } convert_to_feudal_2 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { economic_x_axis = 22 } } convert_to_feudal_3 = yes }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { economic_x_axis = 23 } } convert_to_normal_axis = yes }
	}
}
